description: Fetch stories from an HN feed (top, new, best, ask, show, jobs), with title, URL, score, author, and comment count for each story.

count.description: Number of stories to return. Larger counts take longer.

feed.description: Which HN feed to fetch. "top" includes jobs. "ask" and "show" are Ask HN / Show HN posts.

offset.description: Number of stories to skip from the start of the feed. Use with count for pagination.

name: hn_get_stories

cap.description: The count cap that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: The HN API answered with a 4xx status other than 429 — it rejected the request as built. `upstream_rate_limited`: The HN API answered with HTTP 429. `upstream_unavailable`: The HN API answered with a 5xx status. `upstream_html`: The HN API served an HTML error page with a 200 status, which it does under rate limiting or maintenance. `upstream_malformed`: The HN API answered with a 200 status and a body that is not JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failedIds.description: IDs on this page whose fetch failed after retries. They are not deleted or missing and may load on a later call: retry the page with the same offset, or pass an ID to hn_get_thread to fetch that story alone. Absent when every item on the page loaded.

hasMore.description: Whether more stories are available beyond this page.

notice.description: Agent guidance: the offset to pass for the next page while more stories remain, the IDs that failed to load and how to retry them, or why a page came back empty — offset past the end of the feed, an empty feed, or every item on the page deleted or flagged. Absent on the last page of a non-empty result with no failed IDs.

offset.description: Offset that was applied to this page.

shown.description: Number of stories returned on this page.

stories.description: Stories from the feed, ordered by HN ranking.

items.description: A single story or job posting.

by.description: Author username when provided by HN. Omitted when unknown.

descendants.description: Total comment count. Absent for jobs.

domain.description: Bare hostname derived from url (e.g. "github.com", with leading "www." stripped). Absent when url is missing or unparseable.

id.description: Item ID — use with hn_get_thread to read comments.

score.description: Upvote count when provided by HN. Omitted when unknown.

text.description: Body text for Ask HN / text posts. Use hn_get_thread for full discussion.

time.description: Unix timestamp when provided by HN. Omitted when unknown.

title.description: Story title when provided by HN. Omitted when unknown.

url.description: External link URL. Absent for Ask HN / text posts.

total.description: Total items in the feed (up to 500 for top/new/best, 200 for ask/show/jobs).

truncated.description: True when more stories remain beyond this page (hasMore). Absent on the last page of the feed.

title: Hn Get Stories
